answer: Anchor each identity's submission to a distinct recent ledger transaction it personally attested — one anchor per identity per epoch, duplicate anchors ineligible. A clone fleet sharing one pipeline independently converges on the same anchor and cancels its own rewards: every clone stands at the same vertex as its twins and they collapse into one. Avoiding the collision means feeding each clone an independent data stream, at the cost of real separate sensing. One inlet feeds one sonnet; honest work flows alone while copied work chokes the shared channel.
